purpose: Make real multiple-image catalogs usable without inventing likelihood errors, correct PLCKG287 source-plane family identity, and preserve topology tests when a catalog does not map every image to its published positional-error class.

AS295.publishedPositionLikelihood: one isotropic 0.5 arcsec positional uncertainty for every modeled multiple image
AS295.sourcePlaneFamilyRule: the published non-candidate system identifier is the family identifier

PLCKG287.publishedPositionLikelihood: 0.25 arcsec for images identified in HST and 1 arcsec for images visible only in MUSE
PLCKG287.catalogLimitation: CDS Table C.1 publishes positions, GOLD membership, source, clump, counter-image, and redshift metadata but no per-image HST-versus-MUSE-only flag or positional-error column
PLCKG287.sourcePlaneFamilyRule: X.Y is one source-plane clump family; X alone is only the background-source identifier

acceptanceFixtures: legacy targets without scorePolicy remain position_likelihood and byte-compatible
topology_only accepts families without positional uncertainties and never emits a finite statistical score
position_likelihood still rejects missing or malformed uncertainty arrays
AS295 serializes 18 images in 6 families with published 0.5 arcsec uncertainties
PLCKG287 serializes 47 GOLD images in 17 X.Y clump families with no invented uncertainties
PLCKG287 family identity differs from the superseded 12-source grouping and reports 60 source-profiled observables
hosted JSON schema, preflight, example, OpenAPI, and local worker agree
claimBoundary: A published modeling uncertainty is a likelihood convention and is not necessarily the astrometric centroid error.
Topology-only evaluation can reject a field that predicts too few images, but cannot rank complete fields by chi-square or likelihood.
PLCKG287 may move to position_likelihood only after every GOLD image is mapped to the paper's HST-visible or MUSE-only class by a frozen, independently auditable protocol.
Correcting source-plane clump identity invalidates the earlier descriptive 12-family PLCKG287 import; spent P0713/P0714 artifacts remain preserved as historical evidence.
Neither catalog target validates the submitted gravity equation; each evaluates only the resulting typed photon field.
